## What and why

## Testing

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] Negative test added/updated for any security-relevant change
- [ ] Coverage thresholds still met

## Checklist

- [ ] No secret or key material in logs, code, or history
- [ ] No unjustified new dependency
- [ ] ADR added for any consequential decision (new dependency of substance, protocol/format choice, persistence or crypto change)
- [ ] Docs / `CLAUDE.md` §0 updated if behavior or phase status changed
